english.title: Possess specified medicinal product with intent to supply it otherwise in accordance with a prescription
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), had in your possession a medicinal product, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PRODUCT..), of a description or falling within a class specified in an order under section 58 of the Medicines Act 1968, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ORDER..),with the intention of supplying it, in circumstances corresponding to retail sale, otherwise than in accordance with a prescription given by an appropriate practitioner
english.legislation: Contrary to section 67(3A) and (4) of the Medicines Act 1968
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This CJS Code and Standard offence Wording is now OBSOLETE. Offence repealed by Schedule 35 to the Repealed by the Human Medicines Regs 2012.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Bod â meddiant cynnyrch meddyginiaethol penodedig gan fwriadu ei gyflenwi heb fod yn unol â phresgripsiwn
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), roedd gennych yn eich meddiant gynnyrch meddyginiaethol, sef **(..SPECIFY THE PRODUCT..), a oedd yn cael ei ddisgrifio neu a oedd mewn dosbarth a oedd yn cael ei bennu mewn gorchymyn o dan adran 58 o Ddeddf Meddyginiaethau 1968, sef **(..SPECIFY THE ORDER..), gan fwriadu ei gyflenwi, mewn amgylchiadau a oedd yn cyfateb i adwerthu, heb fod yn unol â phresgripsiwn a roddwyd gan ymarferydd priodol
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i Adran 67(3A) a (4) o Ddeddf Meddyginiaethau 1968
